source: Curated owner/agent-prepared summary of reported Neatlogs dashboard/backend and host observations, not a raw backend export or host log. Owner reported signed-in read-only queries of project 'Complete's project' (US), 2026-10-11 21:57-22:05 UTC; raw responses/logs are not retained here.
provenance_limits: Screenshots show research success (workflow, two tools, one LLM), research timeout (workflow, one tool, no LLM), and agent reply (workflow, one LLM, no tool). They do not display trace/session IDs, producer revision, live/production tags, UTC timestamps or HTTP 422. Exact IDs/times, inputs, production/runtime binding and app responses below are owner-reported and cannot be independently joined to screenshots. Art recovery is summary-only, with one reported workflow span and no screenshot.
cost_limits: Dashboard cost display is not verified billing. Provider-reported cost is exported only when supplied as a finite value; otherwise absent/unknown. No production per-span provider-cost or billing receipts are retained. Reported no further AI spend is based on absent LLM spans/zero reported provider attempts, not independently verified accounting.
inputs: Synthetic or public only: synthetic event titles 'Neatlogs trace check (synthetic)'; public pages en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glastonbury_Festival and olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-2028. No customer data.

stored_traces.app_behaviour: Owner reported HTTP 422 unreadable_link returned to the user and no further AI spend after the failed fetch; no LLM span is shown, but billing was not independently verified

Owner-reported recovery, summary-only: internal error before any image-model call (ops log code=internal, attempts=0, ~23 ms); app answered 200 with procedural art (fallback=procedural). Applies to the observed requests only; raw host/backend evidence is not retained

not_found_in_reported_readback_window.note: Owner reported these 3 of 7 production sessions not found 30+ s later during the queried window. The reported host line '[ops] neatlogs: export accepted (HTTP 200)' is once-only per process and establishes at least one reported success, not every export's acceptance. No per-export counters, session-to-ACK joins, raw responses or finalization results are retained. Client-side loss, server-side loss and delayed finalization remain unresolved; permanent non-storage is unverified. agent-harness#38 concerns separate operations and does not establish this app's cause.
